description: Qudit QAOA with INTERP initialization (Zhou et al., PRX 10, 021067), p = 1..40. energy_per_depth[p-1] is <H_C> at depth p, in the units of Eq. (33).

settings.p1_initialization: lowest-energy point of a uniform grid of 40 values of gamma_1 in [0.02, 3.0] and 41 values of beta_1 in [-pi, pi]
settings.interpolation: INTERP: optimal angles at depth p linearly interpolated to depth p+1
settings.optimizer: L-BFGS-B, analytic gradient, angles bounded to [-pi, pi], maxiter 1000
settings.cost_normalization: the optimizer uses H_C / H_C_std; angles_p40 refer to this normalized Hamiltonian, ordered (gamma_1, beta_1, ..., gamma_40, beta_40)
